name: aukora-kernel
description: Portable deterministic authority verifier and reducer with conformance vectors and a Convex reference application.
author: Peter Viviani / Aumara

scripts.test:fu: node scripts/check-canonical-boundary.mjs --src src/evidence && node scripts/check-canonical-boundary.mjs --src src/council && vitest run --config vitest.fu.config.ts
scripts.test:fu-app: cd apps/fu && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check:boundary && bun run typecheck && bunx vitest run --config ../../vitest.fu-app.config.ts
scripts.test:kernel: npm run test:portable-boundary && npm run typecheck:kernel && npm test --workspace @aukora/kernel && npm run build:kernel && npm run verify:kernel-compatibility && npm run verify:kernel-sbom && npm run verify:kernel-runtimes && npm run verify:kernel-package
scripts.test:release: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:fu && npm run test:fu-app && npm run verify:organism-sources && npm run verify:convex-surface && npm test -- --reporter=dot
